subject: Clarify production blackout window and fallback remedy proposal
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearcart.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: ops@clearcart.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Production incident - us-east-1 blackout (approx 02:14-02:42 UTC)

Hi Grace,

We saw a pretty severe availability gap this morning in us-east-1. Between ~02:14 and ~02:42 UTC our production calls to the Redwood endpoint returned 503s and in many cases fell back to a cached response that returned stale/incorrect outputs. We took the app into degraded mode to avoid returning bad data to customers but lost ~28 checkout conversions in the window.

I've attached a screenshot of the client errors and a small set of request logs for the window (clearcart-error-snapshot.png, clearcart-raw-requests-20270614.tar.gz). Can you confirm the outage window on your side, whether this qualifies under our SLA, and what the remedy/credit path looks like? We need to present something to our finance and ops teams within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Senior Engineering Manager, ClearCart

Tom —

Thanks for the quick note and for the attachments. I’m escalating to SRE (copied: Rishi) to validate the exact service gap and to pull canonical traces. A few quick asks so we can move fast:

- Can you confirm the first observed 503 timestamp on your side and whether any requests returned stale cached content vs outright failures?
- Do you have a conversion impact estimate by minute (you mentioned ~28 checkouts; if you can split by minute that helps sizing credits)
- Are you on Dedicated/Dedicated Reserved capacity or using Hosted API for those calls?

We will confirm the window, eligibility under the SLA, and propose a remediation/credit calculation within 48 hours. If this meets the SLA definitions we’ll also scope an expedited postmortem and provide a timeline for the RCA.

I’ll hold as owner for the remediation coordination.

— Grace O’Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 03:02:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Production incident - us-east-1 blackout (approx 02:14-02:42 UTC)

Grace / team —

Preliminary check of our telemetry indicates an elevated 503 rate on the inference VHost in us-east-1 starting at 02:12:57 UTC and tailing off by 02:41:38 UTC. We’re seeing a correlated spike in the autoscaler retry loop and an eviction event on one allocation group.

Next steps I’m executing now:
- Pulling the canonical request traces and kv-cache eviction logs for 02:10–02:45 UTC.
- Requesting load balancer and gateway logs for the same window.
- Running a quick sanity check to correlate to recent rolling deploys (none scheduled at 02:00 UTC per deployment history).

On eligibility: per the contractual SLA (section 3.2) an availability gap where the platform returns 503s to >1% of production requests for a 30-minute window is eligible for pro-rata credit. I’ll run the exact request-level counts and produce a provisional credit calc (pro-rata token/time-based) once traces are assembled.

I’ll upload artifacts to the ticket and share a recommended credit amount and the suggested postmortem scope by EOD UTC.

— Rishi
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

I’ve included a minute-by-minute checkout loss estimate from our side in the attached CSV inside the tar.gz.

We are on the Hosted API (non-dedicated) for these endpoints — customer account ID CC-8812 if that helps. The business impact is primarily revenue loss and a support spike; finance will want a clear remediation path and exact credit amount.

We would also appreciate the postmortem being prioritized (we’d like an initial summary for our execs within 72 hours).

Tom

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Proposed remediation and postmortem timeline — ClearCart outage 2027-06-14

Tom —

Thank you for the attachments and the conversion-impact breakdown. Rishi and I completed the trace reconciliation this morning. Short summary and next steps: 

1) Confirmed outage window: 02:12:57 UTC — 02:41:38 UTC (28 minutes, 41 seconds). During this period the platform returned 503s for ~2.6% of requests for your account (CC-8812) in us-east-1 and an additional ~0.9% of requests were served from a fallback cache variant that produced stale pricing metadata.

2) Eligibility: This meets the SLA definition for an availability gap eligible for pro-rata credit.

3) Proposed credit: Per the SLA formula (monthly committed spend prorated by minutes of unavailability), we propose a remediation credit of USD 4,320 applied to your next invoice. This figure is provisional pending final billing reconciliation (we will not invoice before you approve).

4) Postmortem and remediation plan:
- Initial executive summary: 72 hours (by 2027-06-18 14:30 UTC).
- Full RCA and mitigations (code + infra changes, autoscaler hardening, and canary adjustments): 21 calendar days.
- Interim mitigation: we will enable a conservative fail-open policy for cache validity and increase autoscaler headroom in us-east-1 for your traffic until mitigations are deployed.

5) Evidence package: Trace bundle + LB logs + affected request list (uploaded to INF-2134).

If you confirm acceptance of the provisional credit we’ll route the credit through Billing and update your HubSpot record. Laura (copied) will coordinate the billing steps and Aditya will be looped on any contractual language.

Apologies again for the impact — we’re treating this as a high-severity remediation for ClearCart.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
